items.idea_pt: Pelipper liga a chuva e o Archaludon dispara Electro Shot sem carregar. Sneasler e Kingambit cobrem o que a água não bate.
items.idea_en: Pelipper sets rain so Archaludon fires Electro Shot without charging. Sneasler and Kingambit cover what water can't hit.
items.how_to_play_pt: Abra com Pelipper + Archaludon ou Pelipper + Sneasler. Tailwind no primeiro turno se o rival for rápido. Troque o Pelipper para renovar a chuva. Incineroar entra para Fake Out e Intimidate.
items.how_to_play_en: Lead Pelipper + Archaludon or Pelipper + Sneasler. Tailwind turn one if the opponent is fast. Switch Pelipper out and back in to reset rain. Incineroar comes in for Fake Out and Intimidate.
items.dangers_pt: Outro clima (sol, areia) apaga a chuva. Rillaboom com Grassy Glide e Gholdengo seguram bem o Archaludon. Trick Room inverte a vantagem da velocidade.
items.dangers_en: Another weather (sun, sand) removes the rain. Rillaboom with Grassy Glide and Gholdengo handle Archaludon well. Trick Room flips the speed advantage.

items.idea_pt: A Mega Charizard Y liga o sol (Drought): Heat Wave forte e Solar Beam sem carregar. O Venusaur fica com velocidade dobrada pelo Chlorophyll.
items.idea_en: Mega Charizard Y sets sun (Drought): strong Heat Wave and Solar Beam with no charge. Venusaur doubles its speed with Chlorophyll.
items.how_to_play_pt: Abra com Charizard + Venusaur ou Whimsicott + Charizard (Tailwind). Mega Evolua no primeiro turno. Sleep Powder em quem ameaça o Charizard. Garchomp e Gholdengo cuidam das Pedras e dos Fogos rivais.
items.how_to_play_en: Lead Charizard + Venusaur or Whimsicott + Charizard (Tailwind). Mega Evolve turn one. Sleep Powder whatever threatens Charizard. Garchomp and Gholdengo handle opposing Rock and Fire types.
items.dangers_pt: Rock Slide e chuva (Pelipper) derrubam o plano. Tyranitar troca o sol por areia. Fake Out no Charizard atrasa tudo.
items.dangers_en: Rock Slide and rain (Pelipper) break the plan. Tyranitar replaces sun with sand. Fake Out on Charizard delays everything.

items.idea_pt: Três Pokémon montam Trick Room e protegem quem monta (Armor Tail e Psychic Surge param Fake Out e golpes de prioridade). Depois os lentos e fortes batem primeiro.
items.idea_en: Three Pokémon set Trick Room and keep the setter safe (Armor Tail and Psychic Surge stop Fake Out and priority). Then the slow, strong ones move first.
items.how_to_play_pt: Abra com Farigiraf + Indeedee-F: Follow Me na Indeedee, Trick Room no Farigiraf. Nos 4 turnos, Tyranitar (Mega), Kingambit e Milotic atacam. Guarde um segundo Trick Room para depois.
items.how_to_play_en: Lead Farigiraf + Indeedee-F: Follow Me with Indeedee, Trick Room with Farigiraf. During the 4 turns, Tyranitar (Mega), Kingambit and Milotic attack. Keep a second Trick Room for later.
items.dangers_pt: Taunt e Imprison bloqueiam o Trick Room. Times que usam Protect enquanto o Trick Room acaba ganham tempo. Golpes de lutador acertam Tyranitar e Kingambit em cheio.
items.dangers_en: Taunt and Imprison block Trick Room. Teams that Protect while the turns run out stall it. Fighting moves hit Tyranitar and Kingambit hard.

items.idea_pt: A dupla mais usada do formato: dois Fake Out, Intimidate e Grassy Glide com prioridade. Gholdengo e Garchomp batem forte; Whimsicott dá Tailwind.
items.idea_en: The format's most used pair: two Fake Outs, Intimidate and priority Grassy Glide. Gholdengo and Garchomp hit hard; Whimsicott gives Tailwind.
items.how_to_play_pt: Comece com Rillaboom + Incineroar para controlar o primeiro turno, ou Whimsicott + Gholdengo para Tailwind. Use U-turn e Parting Shot para trocar e repetir o Fake Out. Rotom-Wash entra contra Fogo e Água.

items.dangers_pt: Trick Room e Pokémon com Inner Focus ou Armor Tail anulam o Fake Out. Volcarona e Charizard castigam Rillaboom e Gholdengo.
items.dangers_en: Trick Room and Pokémon with Inner Focus or Armor Tail shut down Fake Out. Volcarona and Charizard punish Rillaboom and Gholdengo.

items.dangers_pt: Chuva e sol trocam o clima. Água e Lutador acertam Tyranitar e Excadrill. Wide Guard para Rock Slide.
items.dangers_en: Rain and sun change the weather. Water and Fighting moves hit Tyranitar and Excadrill. Wide Guard stops Rock Slide.

items.idea_pt: Tailwind da Mega Salamence (Hyper Voice vira Voador com Aerilate) e muito dano por turno. O objetivo é derrubar dois por turno antes do rival se organizar.
items.idea_en: Tailwind from Mega Salamence (Hyper Voice becomes Flying with Aerilate) and lots of damage per turn. The goal is to KO two per turn before the opponent sets up.
items.how_to_play_pt: Abra com Salamence + Sneasler: Fake Out e Tailwind no primeiro turno. Kingambit fica no fundo (Defiant pune Intimidate). Basculegion fica mais forte a cada aliado derrubado (Last Respects).
items.how_to_play_en: Lead Salamence + Sneasler: Fake Out and Tailwind turn one. Keep Kingambit in the back (Defiant punishes Intimidate). Basculegion gets stronger for each fainted ally (Last Respects).
items.dangers_pt: Trick Room vira o jogo contra você. Intimidate repetido enfraquece Sneasler e Basculegion. Wide Guard e Protect em dupla gastam o Tailwind.
items.dangers_en: Trick Room turns the game against you. Repeated Intimidate weakens Sneasler and Basculegion. Wide Guard and double Protect waste Tailwind.
